title: Sindh Repeal of The Police Order 2002 And Revival of The Police Act 1861 Act 2011

sections.shortTitle: Sindh Repeal of The Police Order 2002 And Revival of The Police Act 1861 Act 2011
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT XXII OF 2011
ACT XXII OF 2011
SINDH (REPEAL OF THE POLICE ORDER, 2002 AND
REVIVAL OF THE POLICE ACT, 1861) ACT, 2011
An Act to repeal the Police Order, 2002 (Chief
Executive's
Order No.22 of 2002) and revive the Police
Act, 1861 (Act No.V
of 1861)
[Gazette of Sindh, Extraordinary,
Part IV,
15th July, 2011]
No.PAS/Legis-B-23/2011, dated 15-7-2011.---The Sindh (Repeal of the Police Order, 2002 and Revival of the
Police Act, 1861) Bill, 2011 having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of Snidh on 13th
July, 2011 and assented
to by the
Governor of Sindh on 14th July, 2011 is hereby published as an
Act of the Legislature of Sindh.
Preamble.---Whereas
it is expedient to repeal the Police Order, 2002 (Chief Executive's Order No.22
of 2002) and revive the Police Act, 1861 (Act No.V of
1861), in the manner hereinafter appearing;
It is hereby enacted as follows :-
1. Short title and commencement.---(1) This Act may be called the Sindh
(Repeal of the Police Order, 2002 and Revival of the Police Act, 1861) Act,
2011.
(2) It shall come into force at once.

No.PAS/Legis-B-23/2011, dated 15-7-2011.---The Sindh (Repeal of the Police Order, 2002 and Revival of the
Police Act, 1861) Bill, 2011 having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of Snidh on 13th
July, 2011 and assented

Governor of Sindh on 14th July, 2011 is hereby published as an

Preamble.---Whereas

It is hereby enacted as follows :-
4. Saving.---Notwithstanding the repeal
of the Police Order, 2002 (Chief Executive's Order No.22 of 2002), all orders
made (including rules, bye-laws, regulations and notifications and other legal
instruments), proceedings taken, appointments made, acts done by any authority
or any person, which were made, taken or done, or purported to have been made,
taken or done thereunder, between the 14th day of
August, 2002 and the date on which this Act comes into force (both days
inclusive), shall continue to remain in force, until altered, repealed or
amended by the Chief Minister or any authority or officer, authorized by him.
